sources.doc: Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1, Q2 2024 shareholder letter, summary results table
sources.explanation: CORRECTED (P10.7 F1) - PROVENANCE ONLY, VALUE UNCHANGED. This record previously asserted 'Direct primary filing agreement. Zero difference.' against accession 0001065280-26-000212 (the Q2 2026 Form 10-Q) with period 'Q2 2026'. That assertion was false: the Q2 2026 10-Q contains no paid-membership or subscriber count at all, because Netflix discontinued quarterly membership reporting after Q4 2024. The VALUE 277,650,000 is correct and was never in dispute - it is Netflix's LAST FILED global streaming paid membership count, and it is the Q2 2024 figure (as of June 30, 2024), not Q2 2026. Verified by reading the originating document: the Q2 2024 shareholder letter (accession 0001065280-24-000199, Exhibit 99.1) reports the row 'Global Streaming Paid Memberships 238.39 247.15 260.28 269.60 277.65' for Q2'23 through Q2'24. The defect was the period label and the accession, not the number. Zero difference holds now against a document that actually carries the figure.
sources.staleness: DISCLOSED: this is the most recent FILED membership figure, not a current one. It is approximately 26 months old as of the 2026-09-02 valuation date. Netflix publishes no later membership count in any subsequent 10-Q or 10-K. It is used as the per-user median basis on that stated basis, not as a proxy for a current subscriber count.

That assertion was false: the Q2 2026 10-Q states no ARM figure anywhere (OP-searched end to end), and a live EDGAR sweep this turn proves $12.10 appears in NO Netflix primary document - absent from the Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 2024 and Q1/Q2/Q3 2025 shareholder letters (regional ARM only, never a $12.10 global figure) and from the 2024 and 2025 10-K filings (no ARM disclosure at all). sources.claim: Cost of Capital / WACC Construction Policy (11.1225%)
sources.explanation: Methodological judgment: Unlevered debt-free capital structure (We = 100%, Wd = 0%) where WACC equals Cost of Equity (ke). Constructed via 10Y US Treasury (4.79% as of 2026-09-01), 1.49 peer-mean beta (2026-08-31), and Damodaran 3-month trailing ERP (4.25% as of 2026-09-01), yielding evaluated WACC of 11.1225%.

Methodological judgment: 10 discrete annual projection periods (5-year explicit growth FY2026-FY2030 + 5-year fade glide FY2031-FY2035) adopted as the sole production valuation horizon, retiring legacy 5-period horizon to comparison status.

sources.claim: Operating Lease Run-Rate Use (FY2025 Annual Cost as Forward Proxy)
sources.explanation: Methodological judgment: While Note 9 operating lease cost of $12,071k is a verified filed historical fact for full-year FY2025, using it directly as the forward annual run-rate proxy for DUOL forward EBITDAR is an analytical judgment under ASC 842 lease capitalization.

Methodological judgment: SOTP is strictly an additive EV/Revenue decomposition of Core Subscription and DET segments, sharing identical multiples and FD denominator. It is excluded from the 3 evidence clusters (0 votes, excluded from breadth, min/max, confidence, and verdict) to prevent double-counting enterprise-relative evidence. PROVENANCE (P10.7 c6 F1, derived live scratch/p107_sotp_cash_disclosure.mjs): forward total 1193853.52k = subs 1152041.08k + DET 41812.44k; median EV/FwdRev 4.6963; subs EV 5410363.57k + DET EV 196364.94k = EV 5606728.51k; + filed-BS net cash 1330423k = equity 6937151.51k / 50061458 shares = 138.5727; core equity 6694191.05k = 133.72, DET equity 242960.46k = 4.85. Lane: src/engine/methods/sotp.js valuateSotp segments.subscriptions.enterpriseValue / segments.det.enterpriseValue (engine exposes segment EVs, no per-share split). BASIS (P10.7 c6 F2): relatives divide by latest-filed BS net cash 1330423 (BOP 1180887 + STI 132979 + LTI 102693 - debt 0 = 1416559, less lease 86136); DCF bridges from rolled cash 1199776.73. Point-in-time relatives use the filed balance sheet; the forward-looking DCF rolls BOP to the valuation date.
